relations.statement: for all s t, pi s = pi t implies pi (U s) = pi (U t); equivalently there exists V with V compose pi = pi compose U
relations.hypotheses: finite carrier, pi surjective onto Observation, U an admitted update

lemmas.statement: Given surjective pi, update U descends through pi (exists V with V.pi = pi.U) iff pi s = pi t implies pi(U s) = pi(U t).
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem descent_iff {S O : Type} (pi : S → O) (U : S → S) (hpi : Function.Surjective pi) : (∃ V : O → O, ∀ s, V (pi s) = pi (U s)) ↔ (∀ s t, pi s = pi t → pi (U s) = pi (U t)) := by sorry

near_misses.claim: Two states agreeing on effect E1 will agree on E1 after any admitted unitary, so E1 observation descends
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Descent fails: states agreeing on E1 can disagree on a second effect E2 after U, so the observation that discards the distinction loses later predictions

near_misses.claim: Replay, metric bounds and terminal receipts together establish realization
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Not the descent criterion; replay forward/backward checks do not imply equal observations stay equal after the update
